method.class: CPU missingness-aware score prediction with budgeted benchmark selection
method.description:
CPU benchmark selection and missing-score inference on real pinned MTEB text-embedding score rows, not generative-model benchmark execution. Starter: rank-four observed-entry ALS with ridge=.1, requested 50 sweeps, greedy posterior variance reduction, ridge inference; all internals are advisory/untrusted. Scientific question: error versus observation budget k=1,2,4,8 under held-out models and held-out family/duplicate components. Any method respecting the observation protocol is eligible; null and negative results are acceptable. No adaptivity or state-change gate is authorized. Historical fit is immutable across new-model trajectories; begin clears only trajectory observations. Only a selected queryable score is disclosed, never target membership/answers, baseline outputs or scoring metadata. Predictions are evaluator-validated finite normalized [0,1] arrays.
Data: pinned results commit, official text-only task definitions from pinned MTEB source; exact declared main-score metric, public bounded range (correlations [-1,1] mapped affinely, other supported metrics [0,1]); compatible task/dataset-revision/split/subset/metric identity. Pick maximal-supported-coverage revision per model (lexicographic tie); modal compatible task revision/metric at >=32 source rows; >=12 integrity-valid observed scores per model. Actual eligible matrix: 253 rows x 135 columns, outer split search=127 and final=126; no production downsampling. Raw semantic documents and full model examples use NFKC/split-join whitespace/sorted JSON/canonical numeric hashes excluding aliases/source IDs/timing. Alias/family/document/row duplicate connected components are allocated greedily by decreasing size then content digest into approximately equal planes BEFORE fitted features. Raw bytes, original source paths, aliases, metric definitions, exclusions, seeds and case manifests are frozen and rechecked. Integrity-only peer hashes/identity commitments contain no candidate inputs or optimization feedback. Within each case historical and test document/example hashes and aliases are disjoint. Family names are explicit lexical-lineage heuristics, not proof of undisclosed model ancestry; leaderboard measurement noise, source missingness and MNAR generalization are limitations. The pinned results tree has no LICENSE; task.md attributes CC0-1.0 and the official current license blob is pinned separately. No historical-license proof is claimed. No benchmark question corpora are used.
Episodes: per seed A=model/alias/duplicate holdout; B=family/duplicate holdout; C=constant observed historical values at column means preserving masks, matched to A; D=independent nonzero cyclic row shifts of each column value/mask pair preserving marginals, matched to A. Require actual informative numeric change and covariance change for D; reject vacuous controls. C removes score variation, not missingness signals. Expected correlation-based advantage weakens under C/D, but a particular degradation direction is NOT a validity/search gate or causal proof. Every actual candidate method is run, never method-name aliases. A required terminal A reset-consistency diagnostic repeats first inputs/seed after primary episodes: all selections must agree and all bounded serialized prediction values differ <=1e-10. It is included in the declared reset transcript; NO additional discretionary trailing replay is executed. Each episode has exactly one reset and fit plus all its new-model trajectories. begin/select/observe/predict boundaries are evaluator owned. No claim about hidden learning is inferred from state hashes or self-reported flags.
Aggregation frozen before scoring: targets uniform inside model row, rows uniform per episode, checkpoint weights .25, statistical seeds uniform, A/B cases .5 each. MAE uses absolute errors; RMSE is sqrt of equally aggregated squared errors. combined_score=1-MAE. C/D and reset consistency have zero primary weight but required completion. Every failed/missing entire episode retains all original error-one contributions, including every baseline/control; no omission or renormalization. Required baseline missingness or any incomplete comparative evidence yields delta=-1 and final CI endpoints=-1. Required baselines (one evaluator thread, no worker subprocess): column means, copy observed global skill, random-selection low-rank, highest-historical-variance low-rank, regularized linear predictor with mean-imputed historical missing features/targets; fit and tune from history only. Candidate and each of five baselines receive the same per-method productive time cap (20 seconds search, 60 final; 1.5 smoke), 6 methods/episode, same reservoir/targets/eight unique queries/checkpoints/requested rank/sweeps; no canonical productive-time minimum exists. Methods execute sequentially with reserved remaining method allowances; required baseline failures are distinct fixed categories and not candidate timeouts.
Final uncertainty: 400 paired family/duplicate-component multinomial resamples (RNG424242), matched group multiplicities across cases/seeds/methods; preserve case/seed hierarchy, bootstrap-only row reweighting, absent episode gain=-1. Five-baseline simultaneous 95% Bonferroni bounds use quantiles .005/.995 per baseline, report minimum lower/upper bounds against strongest comparator. Primary metrics never reweight surviving data. Per-seed evaluator-owned evidence retains row/checkpoint/common-target/all-unqueried losses, baseline losses, query indices, support and resampling components; it makes no claim of full paper completion.
Transport: finite inline JSON only, interface python_rpc_v1:handle; no paths/handles/shared filesystem. upload_start + at most 64 upload_chunk + upload_commit, then fit; each new model uses begin + 8 select + 8 observe + 4 predict =21 calls. Predictions are inline (N<=4096); no state export/import or prediction download RPC exists. Per episode cap=68+21*T INCLUDING reset/start/commit/fit and DECLARED 64 chunks even though current data needs fewer. Sum complete operation_counts tables including C/D and required terminal diagnostic: search 6681, final 9641; evaluator constants and contract match. No other replay/probe/cancel RPC. Upload bounds M,N<=4096; float64 little-endian values followed by uint8 mask, shape and encoding metadata, missing placeholder zero; <=4 MiB decoded chunks, <=256 MiB logical and <=512 MiB outstanding candidate-memory transfer state. Representative full UTF-8 JSON request envelope=5592510 bytes (base64=5592408 for 4194304 decoded bytes), response envelope=81971 bytes for 4096 representative predictions; reserve 65536 additional broker/framing bytes: maximum complete message 5658046, strictly below 64 MiB and intended 8 MiB. Full maximum-chunk mock traces and actual full production shapes tested before freezing.
Runtime: Linux x86_64, tested CPython 3.12.15, NumPy1.26.4, Matplotlib3.9.2, libseccomp.so.2 and native-smoke Landlock ABI>=3. Production authenticated fixed broker proxy is loaded in-process ONLY for exact /broker-code/candidate_proxy.py plus nonempty authenticated socket signal. Native untrusted code runs under TASK_PYTHON (fallback only when unset), clean explicit environment, read-only Landlock allowlist excluding evaluator data, seccomp denying network/process inspection/namespace escape, process-group wall timeout/kill/reap, 8 GiB AS and all-thread CPU limit=ceil(plane wall*3). No user-site/cache or evaluator flags/credentials are forwarded. Production harness independently attests isolation/aggregate CPU/RAM/storage; no candidate telemetry API or unexposed GPU memory is invented. CPU only, 4 aggregate threads (evaluator1,candidate3),16 GiB aggregate RAM, no GPUs. Wrapper installs pinned binary dependency closure in sanitized offline runtime; no task-local venv or custom lock. Native evaluator/entrypoint and imports were tested in a temporary venv with empty HOME and network-denied evaluator launch; temporary environment removed after validation. Latest official conference template, offline LaTeX/compiler and human publication review remain downstream deliverable obligations, not fabricated scaffold artifacts.
Scheduling: one monotonic plane deadline starts before numerical imports; subtract conservative startup120 search/300 final and finish30; smoke wall120/startup5/finish5. Global per-remaining-episode reset6 + cleanup/dispatch5 reserve; per-method work as above, method transition .25 seconds and episode setup .1. Cleanup reserve sums terminate1+kill/reap1+stderr reader<=1 plus dispatch, no baseline child processes. Joint full budgets use reset6 and 6*(work+1.1) seconds/episode, startup/finish included, so search1343.4<=1800, final5173.8<=7200, smoke118<=120. Cleanup, output writing, evaluator baselines/training/scoring and bootstrap are included. Fake-clock tests cover near-cap responses, middle/reset timeouts, slow sequential cleanup, full reset order and fixed failures. Smoke uses at most24 historical/four test rows and two sweeps ONLY, retaining all four checkpoints/control/RPC/loading/metric/output paths; it never certifies production feasibility. Flags only equal to literal1 select smoke or qualification. Qualification requires ordinary production completion independent of comparative competitiveness; schema-valid state self-reports cannot grant or deny scientific mechanism validity.
Search correct: complete ordinary declared integrity/operational/control/reset/payload/query/range checks, no comparative threshold; smoke uses same semantic checks on reduced paths but is not production qualification. Final correct: same checks on sealed disjoint data after harness-owned freeze; no superiority/novelty/publication decision gate. Harness ranks eligible candidates by combined_score descending, earlier ordinal then stable source digest for exact ties; at most three search invocations. Final outcomes are sealed, never optimization feedback. Improvement/publication claims require paired final evidence, multiplicity handling, real rerunnable figures and paper, while null findings remain admissible. No new controller is created. A sufficient-k claim needs a preregistered application tolerance; otherwise curves are descriptive only.

protocol.promotion_rule: At most three complete search invocations. Scientific integrity/operational eligibility requires search correct=true; no comparative improvement threshold. Harness ranks eligible candidates by combined_score descending, exact ties by earlier evaluation ordinal then stable source digest; freeze once before sealed final. Null/negative results remain eligible. No task-local promotion or publication controller.

search_proxies.name: development_outer_components
search_proxies.preserves: Real pinned text-only MTEB, missingness, model/family holdouts, query budgets, matched target sets, baselines, required C/D/reset diagnostics and fixed failure weights.
search_proxies.omits: Disjoint final family/duplicate components, third private statistical seed and publication claim assessment.

search_proxies.name: draft_smoke
search_proxies.preserves: Same resource loading, inline chunk/fit/trajectory/control/checkpoint/metric/aggregation/output paths and scientific predicate.
search_proxies.omits: Full historical/test row counts and 50 fitting sweeps; smoke is not ordinary production feasibility evidence.

search_visible: Development scalar metrics and bounded fixed failure categories from search only.
Evaluator-owned search per-seed row/checkpoint/coverage/query evidence; no private target values or source IDs sent by RPC.
final_sealed: Final histories/targets, private seed-manifest associations, controls, losses, metrics and uncertainty until harness final execution after freeze.
No final score/evidence may choose, modify, promote or restart a candidate search; publication review is harness owned.

required_evidence: A real complete paper PDF and LaTeX source using the chosen latest official ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS template, page-limit compliance and required checklist; no paper is fabricated by scaffold qualification.
Read-only permitted literature evidence and accurate related work, no prohibited paper/title/author/result search, and immediate-stop/extent records for accidental exposure.

All code, pinned dependencies/data acquisition/version/source provenance, licenses and limitations, raw and normalized content/alias/family disjointness audits, frozen split manifests and reproducible seeds/commands.

Actual full production search/final completion and harness freeze/isolation/resource attestations, exact reset/RPC transcripts, complete-message serialization preflight, real C/D/constant/copy/reset evidence and retained failures.

Evaluator-owned normalized MAE/RMSE versus k, matched and all-unqueried diagnostics, model/family holdouts, uncertainty and simultaneous baseline comparisons; no self-reported state mechanism evidence.

Every published number/table/figure reproduced by an actual supplied script/run; report missing/failed/negative runs and bounded applicability to text embeddings, observed support, heuristic families and permitted reservoirs.

Scientific validity, search eligibility and final claim assessment remain separate; no comparative search veto, no causal learning claim from a changed hash, no automatic publication from scalar score, no universal sufficient-k without declared tolerance.
